statements.t: We expect to have three primary revenue streams:
We intend to provide our ALM access points to both businesses and consumers through monthly and annual subscription fees.
We plan to use both technologies distinctly:

Machine learning: Primarily expected to be deployed in our fourth and fifth-generation Arrive Points (“AP4” and “AP5” units) for local IoT (Internet of Things) data processing, edge computing (inferencing) for environment and transactional models, and interactions models for drones and robots.

Artificial intelligence: Used more broadly to analyze and derive insights from our network’s transactional and environmental data through complex AI models, but we will also leverage foundational AI models like ChatGPT or LLaMa for device-based human interactions.
These advanced capabilities will be introduced in our AP5 development and pilot program currently in development.
● End-to-End Solution: We will combine advanced hardware with a powerful software platform and AI/ML capabilities, offering a complete ecosystem for automated exchange.

The common stock of the Company is expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on the Nasdaq Capital Market (“Nasdaq”) under the same symbol “ARAI” when the market opens on November 12, 2026, with the new CUSIP number 04272H303.
The reverse stock split is intended to increase the per share trading price of the Company’s common stock to cure the outstanding Nasdaq deficiency for $1.00 minimum bid price.

The reverse stock split will reduce the number of outstanding shares of the Company’s common stock from approximately 68,773,551 shares pre-reverse split to approximately 1,432,782 shares post-reverse split and the par value of the common stock was adjusted to $0.0001 per share.
These mandatory repayment obligations will continue until such time as the Company’s VWAP exceeds 120% of the Floor Price (i.e., $0.12 per share) for five consecutive Trading Days.

There can be no assurance that the reverse stock split will result in a sustained increase in the market price of our common stock or that our closing bid price will remain at or above $1.00 for the required ten consecutive business days.
The market price of our common stock after a reverse stock split frequently declines, and the reverse split may reduce the liquidity of our common stock.
If we are unable to expand our customer base and generate recurring subscription revenue, our results of operations will remain highly volatile.
We cannot be sure whether global supply chain shortages will impact our future plans.

In order to mitigate supply chain risks, we may need to incur higher costs to secure available inventory and place non-cancelable purchase commitments with our suppliers, which could introduce inventory risk if our forecasts and assumptions prove inaccurate.
Higher costs of components would impact our cash runway and delays in the manufacturing of our Arrive Points would push out our revenue forecasts.

Changes in regulations such as restrictions on autonomous vehicle operation or technical requirements such as size and weight restrictions or limitations on autonomy within a certain geographic area could reduce or limit our ability to generate revenues and/or impact our unit economics in those markets.
We anticipate these revenue streams to continue in future quarters while we develop new revenue models for the autonomous delivery marketplace and AI data insight monetization.
The loss reflects the decline in the Company’s stock price from each issuance date to September 30, 2026, which reduced the expected value of the noteholder’s conversion optionality.
The gain reflects the decline in the Company’s stock price from each issuance date to September 30, 2026, which reduced the expected value of the noteholder’s conversion optionality.

The Company has incurred recurring operating losses and has experienced negative cash flows from operations since inception and expects to continue to do so as it invests in product development, commercialization, and infrastructure.
There can be no assurance that the Company will be able to access funds under the SPA or obtain additional debt or equity financing.
